verdict.rationale: ernd is a corporate card and rewards product for AI vendor spend. A spend platform of this kind could plausibly offer an API with scoped credentials for agents, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents an API, API keys, or least-privilege credential scoping, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
